headline: Space Bunny vanishes; DeepSeek, Zhipu, Xiaomi surge
summary: A mysterious rank-2 model dropped out entirely, while DeepSeek's v4.1-flash holds the top spot at 23.1% share despite a small daily dip. Zhipu AI and Xiaomi both climbed hard—Zhipu now at 11.1% (up 2.4 points in a day), Xiaomi's flash variant hitting an all-time high of 7.2%. OpenAI gained 4.0 points on the day, landing at 11.4%, while Anthropic surged 2.3 points to 5.8%. The top five providers now command 68.2% of tokens.
highlights: DeepSeek, OpenAI, and Zhipu AI hold 52.9% combined
Xiaomi's mimo-v2.6-flash sets new all-time record at 7.2% share
OpenAI's gpt-5.6-sol climbs to rank 9 with 2.9% (all-time high)
Anthropic's claude-opus-5.5 and claude-sonnet-5.5 both hit all-time peaks
Stealth's space-bunny-alpha dropped from rank 2 (16.2% share) entirely
Qwen's qwen3.7-flash debuts at rank 50 with 0.2% share
